outlook.statement: As India accelerates its digital transformation, the demand for reliable, secure, and technology-driven business support services continues to grow. We see significant opportunities in expanding our service portfolio, leveraging advanced technologies, strengthening our digital capabilities, and entering new business segments that align with our long-term growth strategy.

The outlook for the Company remains positive. Increasing outsourcing requirements across industries, growth in digital financial services, expansion of the banking ecosystem, and continued investments in technology are expected to support future business growth.

The Company intends to expand its geographical presence across India, strengthen technology-enabled service delivery, increase market share in the BFSI segment, diversify into new service verticals, enhance customer experience through process automation, and improve operational efficiencies and productivity.
